rows.description: PV cosine integrand: subtract the removable reference with the wrong sign (exp(-kd)cos(kx) + exp(-nu d)cos(nu x))
PV sine integrand: drop the removable-point regulariser entirely (integrate exp(-kd)sin(kx)/(k-nu) through k = nu)
Free-surface Green function: scale the whole kernel by 1+1e-3 (a 0.1% kernel error a converged solver would carry into A and B)
Free-surface Green gradient: return (dg/dz, dg/dx) instead of (dg/dx, dg/dz)
Free-surface kernel: accept nu*depth below the documented validity floor instead of raising
Finite-depth dispersion: return the deep-water root nu instead of solving k tanh(k h) = nu (i.e. silently ignore the bottom)
Propagating mode norm: drop the sinh(2 k0 h)/(2 k0 h) term (N0 = h instead of (h/2)(1 + sinh/(2k0 h)))
Finite-depth group velocity: return cp/2 (the deep-water shortcut) at every depth
Evanescent roots: return the bracket midpoints without Newton polish
Wave amplitude coefficient: scale by 1+1e-2 (a 1% error in the far-field amplitude = 2% in radiated damping)
